pages.text: Cable an $(l:radiocraft:aviation/adsb_receiver)ADS-B receiver$(/l) to the computer (touching, or on its data wire) and the $(item)ADS-B$() program becomes a second display for it. On the left, the scope: range rings, trails, each craft with its track line and flight ID. On the right, the receiver's state and a table of the traffic, nearest first, and the craft you pick in full.

F5 switches the receiver on or off. + and - (or PgUp and PgDn, or the mouse wheel on the scope) change the range; it is the program's own, so the receiver's screen can show another. Up and Down pick a craft; T turns the tags on the scope off and on. Emergency squawks show in red.
A blank floppy and a feather.
